mꜣw: mꜣw — Mau(?), a title of Thoth, in the phrase mꜣw tꜣwy 'the Mau of the Two Lands' (title; reading and sense uncertain; Budge: māau 'recorder')
mi: mi — come! (the imperative that serves the verbs of coming, iwi and ii; in later copies written with the owl m and the forearm ꜥ, as if mꜥ, with the walking legs)
gr: gr — to be silent, still (verb) · a second word of nearly the same spelling: the particle grt 'now, moreover, indeed'
wꜣḏ: wꜣḏ — papyrus stem; papyrus-column, papyrus-sceptre or amulet (noun) · also green, fresh, flourishing (adjective; verb wꜣḏ 'be green') (Budge: 'tablet')
sd: sd — to break (verb; a writing of sḏ 'break', with the hand d for the cobra ḏ)
bsw: bsw — Besu(?), a word not understood, written with a fish classifier; perhaps from bs 'bring in, introduce' (name element; reading and sense uncertain; Budge: besu 'traveller')
pw: pw — this, that (demonstrative, after its noun); 'it is' in nominal sentences (A pw 'it is A') · a second word of the same spelling: who? what? (interrogative pronoun; pw tr 'what then?')
irf: irf — then, now (enclitic particle, from r + ·f; mostly in questions, 'what then?', also after a statement or a command)
m-bꜣḥ: m-bꜣḥ — in the presence of, before (compound preposition: m 'in' + bꜣḥ 'presence', written with the phallus sign bꜣḥ)

__broaden__.in: in — by (naming the agent, as in ḏd in N "said by N"); (particle) it is … · a second word of the same spelling: to say, said (verb; normally after the words quoted: in·sn 'they say', in N 'says N'; in·k 'you said')
__broaden__.hrw: hrw — terror, dread · a second word of the same spelling: day (noun; plural hrww)
__broaden__.·ti: ·ti — you (2nd person singular ending of the stative: "you are …, you have …"; written ·tw here) · also written ·ṯi, with the tethering rope ṯ and the reed (the older spelling)
